scenes.say: To make your videos speak in your own voice, open Settings.
Scroll down to the AI Voice Clone card.
Choose Record my voice. You'll see a short script to read aloud, and you can change it to your own words.
Press Start recording, and talk naturally for at least thirty seconds.
Then press Stop recording, and Use this recording.
Already have a recording? Choose Upload a file instead.
That's it. Every AI video you make now speaks in your voice.
In Spark Studio, everything starts with one question: what do you want to create?
Tap the mic and say it all in one sentence, or type it in the same box.
For example: make a vertical video about why first-time buyers should get pre-approved in Springfield, Illinois.
A moment later, the page fills itself in from what you said: the kind of video, the town, and the shape.
Check it, change anything you like, and press Next.
Or just say, Spark it, and Sparklee presses Next for you.
When your video is ready, open My Sparks.
Find the video, and press Publish.
Your title, description and hashtags are already written for you.
Pick your YouTube channel, and any other accounts you connected.
Post it now, or schedule it for later.
Choose public, unlisted or private, then publish. You're live, without leaving SparkReels.
If a post ever fails, open Publish again to see why, and press Retry.
